package main

import (
	config.(SiteConfig) "config.json"
	_ "github.com/elaous/gojiberry/components/button.css"
	theme "./theme/dark.css"
	logs "events.jsonl"
	"net/http"

	canvas "github.com/elaous/gojiberry/canvas/gox"
)

func Page(people []Person) gox.Node {
	return <section>
		<components.List[Person]
			items={people}
			item={func(p Person) gox.Node {
				return <span>{p.Name}</span>
			}}
		/>
		<canvas.Canvas width={800} height={600} mode={state.Mode}>
			<canvas.TextFlow lockH wrap pages={func(page gox.Node, n int) gox.Node {
				return <>
					<canvas.Header text="Report" />
					{page}
					<canvas.Footer><canvas.PageNumber none /></canvas.Footer>
				</>
			}} />
		</canvas.Canvas>
		<p>plain words here are not attributes</p>
	</section>
}

func cmp(x int, y []int) bool {
	return x<y[0] && y[0] > 1
}
